snippet.title: Stiff Neck – Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Stiff Neck is a psychological visual novel about love, memory, and hidden wounds.
In a quiet coastal town, strange events unfold—a factory strike, cursed dolls, and an unexpected reunion. As Noele’s life starts to unravel, your choices will shape her relationships, reveal her past, and decide how her story ends.
Will you reconnect, let go, or uncover something darker beneath the surface?

#indiegame #visualnovel
